BrochureContent.Content:
Superbly Located detached bungalow with four bedrooms, two receptions mature family home set on beautiful private grounds of c.0.5 acres approx.., featuring large garage/workshop to rear, located only minutes from Enniscorthy Town & M11 Motorway

A most attractive detached property set on beautifully maintained and mature grounds, enjoying an excellent location just 2km from Enniscorthy town centre and only 1.5km from the M11 motorway interchange, providing easy access to Dublin and the surrounding regions.

This very well-presented family home has benefited from a number of recent upgrades and improvements, including a newly remodelled main bathroom, upgraded insulation to both the attic and walls, internal redecoration, and external repainting. The property offers spacious and versatile accommodation extending to approximately 145 sq.m. (1,560 sq.ft.) and is complemented by a substantial workshop and additional storage shed to the rear.

Features

•	Detached four-bedroom bungalow extending to c.145 sq.m.
•	Set on c.0.5 acre of mature, well-maintained grounds.
•	Excellent location close to Enniscorthy town and M11 motorway.
•	uPVC double-glazed windows.
•	Oil-fired central heating with back boiler.
•	Fully fitted kitchen in solid wood 
•	Newly remodelled family bathroom.
•	Two ensuite bedrooms.
•	Recently repainted exterior
•	Internal redecoration completed.
•	Attic and walls fully re-insulated for improved energy efficiency.
•	Large workshop and additional storage shed.
•	Sweeping driveway with ample parking.


Accommodation
Entrance Hallway features laminate flooring, leading to first reception room – sitting room with a bright and spacious reception room featuring laminate flooring and a cast iron open fireplace. Kitchen/Dining is fitted with fully fitted kitchen in solid wood units leading to new second reception room with generous dining and living space and  French doors open directly onto the patio,  creating an ideal space for family living and entertaining. 
Four well-proportioned bedrooms, all with laminate flooring, two with ensuite bathrooms. The main bathroom has recently been remodelled and fully tiled, comprising WC, WHB, bath and wet-room style shower.

Outside
The property is approached by a sweeping driveway that wraps around the residence and is set amidst mature, landscaped gardens, mainly laid to lawn. To the rear is a large workshop together with an additional storage shed, offering excellent potential for a variety of uses. Patio door opens to timber decked patio area and extensive lawns.
